    ans = 1
    while v > 0:
        if v & 1:
            ans = ans * u % p
        u = u * u % p
        v >>= 1
    return ans

    os = 0
    of = 0

        if s[i] == u:
            q[u][0] += 1
            q[u][q[u][0]] = i
            wf[i] = os + 1
            os += 1
    for i in range(1, e[u - 1] + 1):

        for h in range(1 << n):
